title: The Two Causes of Chronic Illness
text: and this is in a nutshell to make it as easy as possible you need two things to be chronically ill two things to have a symptom that won't go away two things that makes your life say let you know the less quality of life two things have to be there toxins and pathogens you need two things there that's what you need and that's what's happening everyone's building a lot of toxins up and they're catching a lot of pathogens that's what's happening and bottom line all these illnesses everything behind autoimmune is a virus or even bacteria involved or both and some poisons for it to feed on so to make it really simple really simple you have certain toxins in your body and they become food for certain bugs pathogens pathogens eat the toxins they release a poison and we all get sick and sicker and sicker
